snippet.title: Isles.gg Discord Bot: Launch Trailer | Free Island RPG
snippet.description:
One command, and the island is yours. Isles is a free RPG you play inside Discord.
Add it to your server: https://isles.gg

Farm your island and arm it with cannons. Fish with your crew and pull monsters out of the deep. Hatch companions, trade with friends and forge your weapons. Hunt the wilds, raise a clan, raid your rivals and take their gold. And when they come for yours, hold your shore.

Every friend in your server gets an island of their own.

0:00 Your island
0:12 Fishing, companions and trading
0:26 Hunting and clans
0:37 Raids
0:50 Free to play on Discord

Play free: https://isles.gg
More games from Eucaly: https://euca.ly
Made by Quartz: https://quartz.gg

Everything on screen is the game's own art.
Music: "Prepare to Fight" by Basil (public domain, opengameart.org)
